verdict.rationale: Fastmail ships first-party Masked Email and alias features, each with its own help article. A long-time customer independently reports using masked emails for throwaway or sketchy sites, which is exactly the sign-up privacy use case. Missing for 10: the evidence pack has only article titles, with no detail on how masked addresses are generated, managed, disabled or shielded on replies, and nothing on how aliases hide the real address when sending.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address

citations.quote: Masked emails have been so nice for throwaway/sketchy sites.
